events.title: Constantine I enters Rome after his victory at the Milvian Bridge
events.description: A day after defeating Maxentius at the Milvian Bridge, Constantine I entered Rome in a grand adventus met with jubilation. He promised to restore the Senate's ancestral privileges, and there was no revenge against Maxentius' supporters.

events.title: Conradin, the last Hohenstaufen, is beheaded in Naples
events.description: Conradin, the last legitimate Hohenstaufen, who at fifteen had invaded Italy to recover Sicily from Charles of Anjou, was beheaded in the market square of Naples after his defeat at Tagliacozzo and capture while fleeing.

events.title: The Mamluks defeat the Ilkhanate at the Second Battle of Homs
events.description: In western Syria, the armies of the Mamluk Sultanate defeated those of the Ilkhanate, a division of the Mongol Empire centred on Iran. The battle was part of Abaqa Khan's attempt to take Syria from the Egyptians.

events.title: Sir Walter Raleigh is beheaded at Westminster
events.description: Courtier, poet and explorer Sir Walter Raleigh was executed in Old Palace Yard under a treason sentence from 1603. James I revived it after Raleigh's failed expedition to Guiana attacked a Spanish settlement.

events.title: Mozart's Don Giovanni premieres in Prague
events.description: Mozart conducted the first performance of Don Giovanni at the Estates Theatre in Prague. The opera, with a libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte, blends comedy and the supernatural and is ranked among the greatest ever written.
events.html: Mozart conducted the first performance of Don Giovanni at the Estates Theatre in Prague. The opera, with a libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte, blends comedy and the supernatural and is ranked among the greatest ever written.

events.title: A Geneva conference founds the Red Cross movement
events.description: An international conference called by the Geneva committee of Henri Dunant closed by adopting resolutions for national relief societies for wounded soldiers. The Red Cross movement and the 1864 Geneva Convention followed.

events.title: Black Tuesday: the Wall Street Crash deepens
events.description: More than 16 million shares were sold in a day of panic on the New York Stock Exchange. Black Tuesday became the emblem of the crash that preceded the Great Depression.
events.html: More than 16 million shares were sold in a day of panic on the New York Stock Exchange. Black Tuesday became the emblem of the crash that preceded the Great Depression.

events.title: Hurricane Sandy makes landfall in New Jersey
events.description: Sandy came ashore near Atlantic City, bringing a record storm surge that flooded lower Manhattan and the New York subway. Across the Caribbean and North America it killed more than 230 people.
